title: Development of Flame-Resistant Cotton Fabrics with Casein Using Pad-dry-cure and Supercritical Fluids Methods
journal: International Journal of Materials Science and Applications
TG_locator: Table 1, journal p. 55; Section 3.2 defines onset as beginning of weight loss and R600 as percent of original weight
LOI_locator: Table 3, journal p. 58; Section 3.4 repeats six matched LOI values
conditions_locator: Section 2.4, journal p. 55 (TG); Introduction p. 54 and Section 2.6 p. 55 (LOI)
pairing_evidence: The same six distinct sample labels appear in TG Table 1 and LOI Table 3, with the same tabulated add-ons and deposition method branches. Section 3.1 cross-references these labels. No second formulation series, post-wash series, or alternative use of the same labels is reported. Conflicting preparation details are withheld rather than used to map states.
source_location: Tables 1 and 3; Sections 2.1-2.4, 2.6, 3.1-3.2 and 3.4; journal pp. 54-58
limitations: PDC urea/DAP bath concentration is inconsistent (1.5% in Section 2.2 versus 10% in Table 1/Section 3.1), so no numeric bath loading asserted. SC process conditions conflict: 90 C/1800-2000 psi in Section 2.3 versus 60 C/1500 psi in Section 3.1, all omitted. PDC-2 add-on 6.3% in tables versus 6.5% in vertical-flame prose and SC-2 18.7% in tables versus 19.7% in thermal prose are omitted from clean metadata. PDC-1 onset omitted due potential range-endpoint attribution conflict. SC dual onsets preserved as two original values, not relabeled T5/T10/Tmax. MCC Table 2 temperatures excluded. Original PDF tables and TG method visually checked.
